author: Marc4360
body:
The fact that Odie is releasing "ascension reversal" at the same time as the Spiked Shield nerf is a big red flag.  From what I've heard, crit has been totally removed from SS, and damage is heavily affected by the enemies defense now.  Not sure how the pvp aspect will be yet, but high floor endless for Gilga is now dead.

As mentioned in other comments, it really depends on your playstyle and what you like.  Ascensions now affect Beowulf pets, so Beo can be incredibly strong; Bahamut at T9 is pretty powerful, especially in the pvp 1 shot meta (Crimson Gazer = OP).  Titanguard can do pretty good in raids assuming you spec Charmer and run Warrior's Pavane with a decent weapon; they can put up a fight in pvp too, but they're not as "easy mode" as Bahamut.

In all honesty, I wouldn't be throwing too many resources towards unlocking Gilga right now at least until we see how Spiked Shield is post-nerf.  Sure Gilga can do other things like Warrior's Pavane or a crit realm strikes build, but you might as well play Realmshifter at that point.

You can't go wrong unlocking Titanguard because Divine Bastion 2 is pretty much required for T10 raiding and endgame content.  Beowulf is pretty powerful with ascension levels so you can't really go wrong getting Bahamut either.  I guess it really depends if you want to be a pet sitter or not.

author: Markemberke
body: For T9, the most important thing to do is to farm Apollyon 0-24. For that Bahamut is not so good. Nyx is the god in terms of Apollyon ass whoopping, but if that's not possible, then be Titanguard. It'll be very slow but effective. 👍 For T10 you can be pet class, Beowulf is awesome. But for T9, raiding Apollyon is the most important thing and for that Bahamut is not that good. So I recommend you Titanguard. 👍

author: Odeken
body: Imo I loved titanguard. The dps will be slow but you can survive a crazy amount of things. When I hit level 210 I went charmer and the dps increase was huge.

author: petr1petr
body:
it depends on what you like more.. 

This month, there should be "nerf" of spiked shield, so maybe pet class would be better..

on the other hand, to be honest, I am not expecting huge nerf - too many gilgas out there.. just have a look, how long have passed from the previous balance patch, that was supposed to nerf SS..

so really, play whatever feels right to you - it will take some time, to reach 225, so better to have fun during the time. or just raise enough orns to try both.. 

bahamut is really strong in pvp with CG (on the given tier). currently, with all the buffs to it, you can play it with different specialization, which may be fun. note, that you will need more pets for different content, so you will spend orns on pets..

author: thenickpeppers
body:
Yeah I wouldn't recommend Gilga as your first T10 unlock. Spiked Shield only becomes viable once you get SS 2/3 and 80k plus ward. Although Diffuse Ward is awesome and you'll rarely have to use potions ever again. 

I hit 225 a few weeks ago and got lucky with an Ornate Axe of Gilgamesh but until I find better head and leg pieces for more ward and hit 230 for SS 2 it's not worth switching from Charmer so I just kept using Warriors Pavane for the time being since it has higher dps.
